scope: C2 personal plan, guided activities, opt-in device progress and student-selected appointment notes
environment: Local Next.js development website at http://127.0.0.1:3000/wellness; Windows browser

coverageExamples: Confirmed topics and explicit workload answers change the suggested activity
Activity back navigation preserves writing; completion records omit writing
Concerning activity text shows the existing human-support panel
Device storage is untouched before explicit acknowledgement/opening
Progress schema rejects invalid or duplicate entries and strips arbitrary fields
History is capped at 100 records without modifying unrelated storage keys
Storage failures do not claim a confirmed save
Session clearing removes drafts and preserves explicitly saved records
Appointment fields are excluded by default; downloaded text equals the selected preview

browserChecks.actualDistilBertTopicInference: passed: study/worry example and study-only example
browserChecks.deleteAllOwnSoftwareTestRecords: passed; four invented records created during verification, all removed
browserChecks.appointmentSelectionAndDownloadRequest: passed; no booking or message sent

limits: All browser inputs and saved entries used for verification were invented software-test examples, not student health records.
Original activity prompts await professional review and have no clinical validation.
No new clinical, participant, treatment-outcome or usability measurements were collected.
Device history is readable by anyone using the browser profile, is not cross-device account storage, and requires a deliberate acknowledgement before opening.
Appointment notes download as plain text; no automatic professional sharing or new counselor access control is implemented.
No production build, Vercel deployment, real-device mobile test or cloud model availability is established by these local checks.
Existing model limitations, optional facial fusion and independent local evaluation remain unresolved research work.
